clue.text: Mood shown by couple on short piece of film

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another follows it
short means the film clip loses its last letter, cut short

parts.note: a clip is a short extract of film
to couple is to pair up or mate

explanation.surface: A film editor sets a mood by joining two shots onto a brief clip.
explanation.definitionFit: The prevailing mood or atmosphere of a place or time is its climate, as in a climate of fear.

clue.text: Suspend during church reform

indicators.note: during means the word for suspend sits inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
to suspend is to hang

explanation.surface: Reform is put on hold while the church deliberates.
explanation.definitionFit: To reform something is to alter it, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Independent head of private new hospital department lost without doubt

indicators.note: lost says these letters go missing from the word Independent
head of picks the first letter of private

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

explanation.surface: A private hospital going independent loses a department, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove P, N and ENT, in that order, from INDEPENDENT: IND-E-(P)-E-(N)-D-(ENT) leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean certainly or truly, used to affirm a statement beyond question.

clue.text: Notice decorations lacking tip of attractive frills

parts.note: a notice in a paper is an advertisement, AD

indicators.note: lacking means a letter is taken out of the ornaments

parts.note: decorations are ornaments

indicators.note: tip of picks the first letter of attractive

explanation.surface: A notice announces decorations without any of the attractive frills.
explanation.definitionFit: Frills are extra ornamental touches, embellishments added for decoration.

clue.text: Poetic inspiration from French art — silly rot

parts.note: in French, tu es is thou art, so art is ES

indicators.note: silly says the letters of rot are jumbled

explanation.surface: A poet dismisses French art as silly rot rather than inspiration.
explanation.definitionFit: Estro is a literary word, from Italian, for poetic enthusiasm or creative fire.

clue.text: 14 rising from Section admitting member

definitions.note: with 14 across in place, this means heat levels going up

indicators.note: admitting means the section takes the member inside it

parts.note: a wing is a section of a building or party
an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A hospital section is heating up after admitting a member.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat levels going up is a process of getting hotter, the sense of global heating.

clue.text: Find USSR with suspect planes over the sea

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters are not in their proper order

explanation.surface: A spy-thriller order to locate Soviet suspect planes flying over the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: To plane is to skim over water; a sailboarder glides across the sea on a board.

clue.text: Journey East to free the leader

indicators.note: to means the East letter is attached to the end

parts.note: to free a group of its leader is to rid it of him
E is the compass abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: A journey eastward to liberate a captured leader.
explanation.walkthrough: The blog reads only RID (free) plus E; 'the leader' is best taken with 'free' as the thing got rid of.
explanation.definitionFit: A ride is a trip in or on a vehicle or horse, a kind of journey.

clue.text: Setter's old, funny and latterly ignoring the odds getting extreme admiration

parts.note: the setter speaks of themselves as I

indicators.note: funny means odd, so the letters of old are rearranged
ignoring the odds keeps the even letters of latterly

explanation.surface: A setter confesses being old and funny draws excessive admiration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'funny' rearranges OLD to DOL; the even letters of LATTERLY give ATRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Idol worship, carried over to people, means excessive adoration or devotion.

clue.text: During drive home, dad's overtaken

parts.note: to go is to drive or travel

indicators.note: During puts dad inside the drive-home phrase

parts.note: a nest is a home
PA is dad; the 's is dad is

explanation.surface: On the drive home, Dad's car is overtaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has been passed by another vehicle has been overtaken.

clue.text: Regularly valued bijou is sound

indicators.note: Regularly takes every other letter, here the even ones, from valued bijou

explanation.surface: A valued little jewel is in good condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio is recorded or reproduced sound, as opposed to video.

clue.text: Less 27 1D on time, with break of day

definitions.note: with 27 across, this reads less extreme

indicators.note: in an across clue, the cross-reference follows the time letter
with here means the first letter of day is placed among the letters of one down

parts.note: the reference 1D is read literally as one down

indicators.note: break of day is daybreak, the start of day, its first letter

explanation.surface: A puzzle cross-reference that sounds like a schedule note about dawn.
explanation.walkthrough: Ignore what 1 down means: its label is read literally, 'with' sets the start of day inside it, and 'on' puts it after the time letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderated or softened, made less extreme or intense, as with a toned down speech.

clue.text: A place for growing protest about English space research's closure

indicators.note: about means the protest goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to grouse is to complain or protest
an en is a printer's space

indicators.note: closure takes the last letter of research's

explanation.surface: Protesters object as an English space research centre is closed.
explanation.definitionFit: A glasshouse in which plants are raised is a structure for cultivating them.

clue.text: Firstly getting asthmatic, so pant

indicators.note: Firstly takes the opening letter of each of the four words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone becoming asthmatic struggles for breath.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and the scene: an asthmatic person's first reaction is to gulp for air.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp intake of breath is exactly what an asthmatic attack prompts.

clue.text: Revealing game to be OK with European after this instruction

parts.words: OK with European after this instruction
parts.note: OK followed by E for European is what remains once the outer letters come off a card game's name, the instruction the answer gives

explanation.surface: An invitation to play a revealing game, provided a European agrees.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: remove the outside letters of POKER and OKE remains, which is OK plus E. 'to be' is the link to that reading.
explanation.definitionFit: A card game in which losing players shed clothing, so it reveals a lot.

clue.text: Moderate characters beginning to drop degree classifications

parts.note: to temper is to moderate

indicators.note: beginning to drop removes the opening letter of the word for characters

parts.note: a person's nature is their character

explanation.surface: University degree classes are moderated as some candidates drop out.
explanation.definitionFit: Readings in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit classify how hot things are, a cryptic take on degree classes.

clue.text: Make more than one place on river with pronounced views

parts.note: the Ural is a river in Russia and Kazakhstan

indicators.note: pronounced says a word is said aloud and spelt by its sound

parts.note: eyes are a person's views, as in in my eyes

explanation.surface: An estate agent multiplies a riverside place with striking views.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammatically, to form the plural of a word is to make it denote more than one.

clue.text: Pneumatic arm is initially frailer when modified

indicators.note: when modified says the letters are altered into a new order
initially takes the first letter of is

explanation.surface: An artificial pneumatic limb becomes weaker when adjusted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arm' looks like a limb but means weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun firing pellets by compressed air is a pneumatic weapon, arm being firearm.

clue.text: Where one pays to listen to opinion of some Brexiteers?

indicators.note: to listen to means the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: some who backed Britain leaving the EU would like the Czech Republic to leave too: Czech out

explanation.surface: A wry question about where you settle up, and what Leavers say.
explanation.walkthrough: Brexiteers are those who backed the UK leaving the European Union; CZECH OUT, said aloud, matches a till point.
explanation.definitionFit: The till point in a supermarket is where shoppers pay for their goods.

clue.text: Following closely to this, I run up shattered

indicators.note: shattered means broken into pieces, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A jogger trailing someone arrives exhausted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shattered' looks like tiredness but scrambles TO THIS I RUN UP.
explanation.definitionFit: Chasing hard, right behind a quarry, is the idiom's sense of close pursuit.

clue.text: Substance, one that provides energy shortly before working

parts.note: a carb, short for carbohydrate, is an energy food
ON means operating or working

explanation.surface: An energy-giving substance taken just before a workout.
explanation.definitionFit: The element is a chemical substance, so a general term covers it.

clue.text: Throw girl keeps as blanket

indicators.note: keeps means the girl holds the throw inside her

parts.note: GAL is a colloquial girl
to lob is to throw high

explanation.surface: A girl wraps herself in a throw like a blanket.
explanation.definitionFit: A blanket ban is all-embracing; a worldwide, comprehensive scope is the adjective's meaning.

clue.text: Career suggestion after scratching the head

indicators.note: scratching the head removes the first letter of the word for suggestion

parts.note: a trace is a hint or suggestion

explanation.surface: Someone scratches their head over a career suggestion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Career' is the verb, to rush along.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to hurtle along at speed, so dashing fits as a verb.

clue.text: Reminder to stir duck paella wife cooked omitting last of squid

indicators.note: cooked means the ingredients are mixed into a new order
last of takes the final letter of squid, which is left out

explanation.surface: A recipe nag: remember to stir the duck paella, with no squid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'omitting' signals that the squid's final letter comes out of the pool before 'cooked' mixes it; 'stir' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A morning alarm call literally rouses a sleeper; figuratively it is a jolt or warning.

clue.text: More paintings by Magritte — his last retrospective coming up

indicators.note: a retrospective looks back, and coming up in a down clue reads the letters upwards

parts.note: paintings are art
X is the multiplication sign, read as by in three by four

indicators.note: his last takes the final letter of Magritte

explanation.surface: More Magritte paintings will feature in his forthcoming retrospective.
explanation.definitionFit: Additional means extra, as in extra helpings or more of them.

clue.text: Final two in House after accepted start of parliamentary recess

indicators.note: after puts the last two letters of House behind the rest
start of takes the first letter of parliamentary
Final two in takes the last two letters of House

explanation.surface: The House rises for parliamentary recess once two final bills are accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recess' looks like a parliamentary break but is a church alcove.
explanation.definitionFit: A rounded alcove at the end of a church, typically behind the altar, is an architectural recess.

clue.text: Impressive profile

parts.note: a mark pressed into the ground is literally an impression, and the outline of a foot is its profile; also the area or impact something covers

explanation.surface: A tribute to someone with a notable public image.
explanation.walkthrough: In this puzzle's theme, the carbon kind measures environmental impact.
explanation.definitionFit: A shape left in sand or mud is an impression of a sole, and figuratively the space or impact something occupies.

clue.text: Fast food produced by British bake-off

indicators.note: off means gone bad, so the letters are spoiled into another order

explanation.surface: A British baking contest yields a takeaway.
explanation.walkthrough: A bake-off is a baking competition; here 'off' scrambles B and BAKE.
explanation.definitionFit: Grilled meat in pitta or on skewers is a staple takeaway, a type of quick meal.

clue.text: Part of sex tremendously far out

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A racy line about something wildly enjoyable.
explanation.definitionFit: Far out is slang for radical or way beyond the usual, a synonym for at the limit.

clue.text: Two ways adult rejected gland

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the letters read in reverse

parts.note: two roads: LANE and RD, the abbreviation for road
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: An adult rejects two ways of treating a gland problem.
explanation.definitionFit: The adrenals are endocrine organs above the kidneys, producing adrenaline.
